page.layout: One column of text on one printed page. Above the text, the running head and page number. Table lines of overbarred numerals at the top, then running text and italic question headings. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Minore numero ante majorem posito, qui semper detrahit majori tantum, quan-tum ipse minor significat,hoc modo:

Triplex: Digitus, qui denario minor est, ut sunt novem simplices numeri: 1,2, 3, 4,5, 6,7,8,9, Articulus, qui in decem æquales partes dividi potest: ut,10.20.30. 40. 50.60. 70.80.90.Compositus,qui ex digito & articulo constat:ut,11.12.13.14.15.
Si primo loco a dextra versus sinistram notæ fuerint: retinent nativū suū valoré. Si secūdo loco duo fuerint, designant viginti,

page.notes: The overbars on V, X and L (thousands) are drawn as macrons and are written here as combining macrons. The numeral for 900 is a damaged form, read as CM with a doubt mark. The "IIX." entry is printed as shown. Spacing is as printed, e.g. "significat,hoc" and "numeri: 1,2, 3". The paragraph continues onto the next page.
